52 models by Kenney (https://kenney.nl), licensed CC0.
Sources: https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit (28 models), https://kenney.nl/assets/fantasy-town-kit (24 models).
Original license files included alongside these assets. Original OBJ geometry converted to compact per-model JSON; texture palette baked into linear vertex colors. Models loaded on demand and geometry shared between instances. Thumbnails supplied by Kenney.
